Name: Swim - Continued
Author: FlyingTNT
Description:
This is a continuation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6326]Swim[/url] by aedenthorn.

[i]The original mod was featured in articles in [/i][url=https://www.pcgamer.com/you-can-now-swim-in-ponds-rivers-and-oceans-with-this-stardew-valley-mod/]PC Gamer[/url][i], [/i][url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2020/07/01/go-swimming-in-stardew-valley-with-this-new-mod/]RockPaperShotgun[/url][i], and [/i][url=https://www.thegamer.com/stardew-valley-swimming-ocean-mod/]TheGamer[/url][i]![/i]

Based on Platonymous's Swim (Almost) Anywhere proof-of-concept, this mod lets you jump into the rivers, lakes, ponds, and oceans of Stardew Valley.


[youtube]G33bHckFo5k[/youtube]
[size=5]Features:[/size]

[list]
[*]Toggle jumping into water using J (customizable)
[*]Jump in and out of water by pushing towards the water's edge.
[*]Jumping into water puts on your swimsuit, jumping out takes it off.
[*]Toggle wearing swimsuit on land using K (customizable).
[*]Use tools while swimming and in swimsuit.
[*]Travel by water between the mountain, town, beach, and forest by swimming to the map edge.
[*]Dive under the ocean and mountain lake using H (customizable).
[*]Play with rainbow-coloured fishies and hermit crabs under the sea and big fishes in the mountain lake.
[*]Collect resources and treasure from the ocean, mine minerals and artifacts from the mountain lake.
[*]Oxygen depletion while underwater is based on player's max stamina (multiplier available in config) - also, bubbles. 
[*]There is rumoured to be special gear hidden in the depths that might improve your swimming and diving...
[/list]
Artifact spots in the mountain lake look like lily pad shadows... but there's no lily pad above!

You can now create your own Swim Mod Info content packs that add dive info, underwater features, and edge warps to maps! Info on creating Swim Mod Info content packs is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/438]here[/url].

[size=5]Gratitude:[/size]

Big thanks to Platonymous for the base code of this mod, and the rest of the core Stardew modding community for their great work on SMAPI etc.

Also grateful to Concerned Ape for SDV and [url=https://github.com/pardeike]pardeike[/url] for HarmonyLib.

Big fish sprites belong to whtdragon and were borrowed from [url=https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/whtdragons-animals-and-running-horses-now-with-more-dragons.53552/]here[/url]. Thanks for making them freely available!

Thank you also to those who provided translations!

In addition to those thanks from aedenthorn, I (FlyingTNT) would like to thank aedenthorn for making this mod in the first place. They are the reason that I got into modding at all, and will always be my #1 inspiration.


[size=5]Technical:[/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/FlyingTNT/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/FlyingTNT/StardewValleyMods[/url].
